summary: Wave 105.4 Razorpay Standard Checkout integration + Supabase key rotation regression fully validated. Created /app/backend/tests/test_wave105_razorpay_regression.py with 18 tests covering create-order (happy path, min-amount 400, non-INR 400, receipt >40 chars trimmed & accepted), verify-payment (valid HMAC-SHA256 signature returns {ok:true, verified:true}, bad signature 400, empty order_id/payment_id/signature all 400), KEY_SECRET leakage checks against GET / and /static/js/*.js bundles (zero hits), rate limit 30/min triggering 429 within a rapid burst, and all four regression endpoints after Supabase service key rotation (admin login + /api/auth/me returning role=admin, /api/printers?limit=3 public feed, /api/compatible-resolve?q=BTD60BK returning tier=1 with /consumable/ url, /api/auth/logout with & without token both 200). Result: 18/18 passed in 11.36s.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/payments.py cleanly uses constant-time HMAC compare (hmac.compare_digest) — good.
KEY_SECRET is read from env and only KEY_ID (public) is ever returned in responses — verified no leak in HTML or JS bundles.
Endpoints are correctly rate-limited with slowapi @limiter.limit('30/minute'); confirmed 429 fires under burst.
Receipt >40 chars silently trimmed rather than 400ing — good UX choice, matches Razorpay's 40-char cap.
Both payment endpoints are unauthenticated by design (guest checkout supported); signature verification is the trust boundary — this is acceptable and documented.
No _id serialization or async issues observed in this router.
seed_data_creation: None — only Razorpay TEST mode orders created via test key rzp_test_TNmhleNQpa6wN4 (no DB writes).
